response.overview: Edgar works as a doctor at a small clinic. One day, one of his patients, Mr. Karastoni, tells him that he has had a premonition in which Edgar suffers a serious accident… This short film was shot in 2006, but some footage was missing, preventing its completion. FJ García added a presenter and rearranged some of the scenes to finish editing the short film.
response.title: La clínica
